name: Confusion

upcast.text: The Sphere's radius increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 4.

summary: 10-foot-radius Sphere: Wis save or creatures act at random (d10 each turn) and lose Bonus Actions and Reactions.
text: Each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure it can't take Bonus Actions or Reactions, and at the start of each of its turns it rolls 1d10 to see what it does: 1, it uses all its movement to move in a random direction (roll 1d4 for north, east, south or west) and takes no action; 2-6, it doesn't move or take actions; 7-8, it doesn't move and makes one melee attack against a random creature within its reach, or does nothing if none is in reach; 9-10, it acts and moves normally. At the end of each of its turns, an affected creature repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success. Concentration, up to 1 minute. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the Sphere's radius increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 4.
